dex.entry: A half-formed moss-treeling that has grown a cloak of living bioluminescent fronds; when it opens its arms the spore cloud it releases can confuse or sedate an entire clearing. A walking haunted coat of moss — kids will love the idea of a kin that is basically a living cloak.

art.silhouette: Short bipedal figure draped in a thick cape of glowing green moss-fronds; a wooden face-plate with amber eyes showing through the moss hood; stubby arms ending in leaf-fans; a round body hidden under the living mantle; warm and eerie at 32px.
